scopeNote: This pass researched and populated only identity/geography and monthly climate normals. Visa/tax/healthcare/airport categories were NOT populated this pass - left genuinely blank per the non-negotiable rules, not fabricated.

facts.note: Matches legacy destinations.ts and existing Supabase row exactly - no conflict.

facts.sourceName: Wikipedia (Kyoto) infobox gives only a highest-point (971 m) and lowest-point (9 m) range for the municipality, not a single representative city-center elevation
facts.note: Left blank rather than arbitrarily pick a value from the range - would be an inference, not a fact.

facts.sourceName: City of Kyoto, Estimated Population (推計人口), via Wikipedia infobox citation
facts.note: City-proper figure, 9th-largest city in Japan by population per the same source. Distinct from the metro figure - do not mix levels.

facts.sourceName: Wikipedia (Kyoto) infobox, Metro row, citing Japan Statistics Bureau / regional definitions
facts.note: Explicitly the Greater Kyoto metropolitan area, distinct from the smaller city-proper population and the larger Keihanshin (Kyoto-Osaka-Kobe) metropolitan area, which was not used here.

facts.sourceName: Wikipedia (Kyoto) infobox: Time zone UTC+09:00 (Japan Standard Time, no DST)
National currency of Japan (uncontroversial national fact)
Official language of Japan (uncontroversial national fact)
Kyoto City Official Travel Guide - City of Kyoto and Kyoto City Tourism Association
facts.note: Distinct from https://www.city.kyoto.lg.jp/ (the general municipal government site, Japanese-language) - chose the official tourism-specific English site as the more appropriate official_tourism_url value.

facts.sourceName: Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA), climate normal 1991-2020, station block_no 47759, via Wikipedia's cited climate table
facts.note: avg_high_c and avg_low_c from 'Mean daily maximum'/'Mean daily minimum'; rainfall_mm from 'Average precipitation'; humidity_pct and sunshine_hours and snowfall_cm also available and populated from the same official JMA-sourced table.
